generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details for reference
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditors reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPPP-Portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund and Contractors should Follow strictly prevailing rules of labour act.

The tenderer should be a PWD registered Contractor - Class-4 and above also Contractors should have Registration of GST, Employers Provident Fund and tenderer should submit Registration Certificate along with technical bid.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

The Tenderer should submit the scanned copy of the last 5 years balance sheet indicating the civil work contract receipts certified by the chartered accountant. Submit the balance sheet indicating the contract receipts certified by the chartered accountant with UDIN No/Auditor & Tax consultant with their registration no, who ever is applicable.

Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Government orders. The item rates quoted shall include cost of royalty charges on construction materials & other taxes as per the rates provided in prevailing cost & conveyance of all materials, Curing, Watering, unloading with all leads & lifts labor, hire charges of machinery equipment etc., complete including all incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer in charge of the work
To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should furnish qualification information as per section 3 of Standard Tender Document attached to this tender

The bidder shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs. The tender fee is non-refundable and The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP portal.

Only Original documents to be scanned and uploaded, Executive Engineer reserves the right verify the Original Documents before approval, original documents/Certificate for qualification shall be produced when called for during evaluation of tender.
All the Formats prescribed in the bid Documents shall be filled in Complete manner.

The materials like bitumen, Steel, Cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should be got tested by the Quality Control Authority before use on the work and contractor should carryout additional test required if insisted by Engineer in charge of work at his own cost.

As per Governmnet order No-FD 417 Exp -12/2024 dated:09.08.2024, The rates are exclusive of GST. The contractor has to quote the rates without GST. As per Govt. order FD:447:Exependiture:12/2022 Bangalore dt. 30-7-2022 GST 18% will be added to the contract amount separately.

Estimate rates are excluding GST as per Common SR 2023-24 and prevailing GST (18% of Amount Put to Tender) amount is kept in form of Lump sum in sanctioned estimate accroding to guidelines in Common SR (GO:PWD 51 RDF 2019 Bangaluru Dt:18.03.2022). Therefore amount put to Tender and ECV amount are excluding GST. KPPP-PORTAL format has No Options to add GST Seperately at stage of Draft Tender Schedule Process for Over ALL amount put to tender, tender has been inviting through an Option with INCLUSIVE. but the item wise rates do not include GST. Hence, GST will be paid seperately for the quoted amount accrodingly. Declaration Certificate must be attached mandatorily.
The Employer reserves the rights to accept any Tender and to reject any or all Tenders as per Standard Tender Document Clause 22.
The defective liability period upto 1 year

Tender shall obtain the work done Certificate in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority no below the rank of Executive Engineer (District Level Officer) and scan the Original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the Tender. The Original Certificate shall be produced at the time of Opening of Technical Bids for Physical Verification, If sought.

Bidder should upload the bid capacity calculated as per KW-1 tender condition, The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent. False representations in the statements leads to disqualification of the tender as per clause 3.1

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and compete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.
Contractor should take all precautionary measures to avoid any damage to the utilities during excavation as well as utility shifting. To that extent the contractor should indemnify the client.

The Successful bidder has to follow the prevailing Government orders regarding Royalty charges. The Contractor has to submit an MDP Certificate along with the running contractor bills. Otherwise the Department will take necessary action as per the government Orders/Circulars.
Any deviation/error/mistakes found in units of items, they should be read as unified SR 2023-24 and the rates shall be quoted accordingly

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost.
The contractor should be responsible for all deduction of the labours wages as per the Labour Act.The Public Works Department will not be held responsible for the same.
Contractors has to upload the EPF Registration with Challan Copy. Contractors has to submit their labour EPF details with every Running Bill
Materials like steel, cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the quality control authority before use on the work at their own cost.
Name, address, and telephone, telex, Email-id and fax numbers of the Tenderers may provide references if contacted by the Employer
The contractor should up-load Caste Certificate of ST Compulsory.

The Contractor belonging to ST shall be domicile of the state of Karnataka for more than 10 years He should scan & upload Domicile Residential Certificate for Residing in Karnataka for more than 10 years by the Competent Authority.

The Contractor has to quote the same rate to the same items of work that is to be executed at different chainages. If in case, the Contractor quotes different rates for the same item appearing at different places of BOQ then, the lowest Quoted Rate for the same items will be considered for that particular item for evaluation and payment.

Item code 10.15ii in Vol 3 of 2023-24 continued SR should be read as Patching of Deep Potholes 75mm thick by restoring the Granular Base course using material confirming to WBM Grade II with type B Screenings standards wherever necessary by manual means including trimming the pothole to the required shape and size, cleaning the pothole, applying Prime Coat SSI at 0.70kg per sqm over the WBM surface and covering the surface with SDBC 25mm thick including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc, complete as per specification.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: KPWD Class IV and above Registration
The contractor belonging to ST should upload Caste Certificate issued by Competent Authority.
The contractor belonging to ST shall be domicile of the State of Karnataka for more than 10 years. Should upload Certificate issued by Competent Authority

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23 ,2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 3.2-a achieved in at least ONE financial year a minimum financial turnover of Rs. 8.07 Lakhs, in all classes of Civil Engineering Construction works only- Balance sheet & Profit & Loss Account indicating contract receipts issued by the Chartered Accountant with UDIN number
Existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 3 months in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer District Level Officer

Tenderers, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value i.e. AxNx5.0 - B as per KW-1. The Bidder must submit the balance sheet indicating the contract receipts certified by the Chartered Accountant with UDIN number/Workdone Certificate issued by not below the rank of EE for computing the value of A and B for the last five years.
Contractor has to upload GST Declaration Certificate in the prescribed format.
Contractors has to upload the EPF Registration with Challan AUGUST 2026
Name, address, and telephone, telex, and fax numbers of the Tenderers may provide references if contacted by the Employer

itemList.description: Clearing  &  grubbing  road  land  including  vegetation,  bushes, shrubs, saplings by using weed cutter / minor equipment. ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour,hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges etc.. complete as directed as per specification and direction of Engineer in-charge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Drains - The maintenance of drains include erosion, repair, clearing, cleaning,  reshaping,  regrading,  deepening  of  side  drains as well as catch water drains as per technical specification Clause 1908. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1908 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour,hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges etc.. complete as directed as per specification and direction of Engineer in-charge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Surface Drains in Soil - Construction  of    unlined  surface  drains  of  average  cross- sectional  area  0.40  m2  in  soil  to  specified  lines,  grades, levels  and  dimensions.  Excavated  material  to  be  used  in embankment with a lift upto 3m and lead of 50 m (average lead 25 m) as per Technical Specification Clause 307. - Mechanical Means. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 307 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour,hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges etc.. complete as directed as per specification and direction of Engineer in-charge of the work.

Manual Means -
Construction of Embankment with approved materials deposited at site from roadway cutting and excavation from drain and foundation of other structures graded with desired compaction. (Royalty shall be recovered @ Rs. 60.00/m³) ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour,hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges etc.. complete as directed as per specification and direction of Engineer in-charge of the work.

Maintenance of Earthen Shoulder (filling with fresh soil) - Making  up  loss  of  material/  irregularities  on  shoulder  to  the design level by adding fresh approved soil and compacting it with appropriate equipment.Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour,hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges etc.. complete as directed as per specification and direction of Engineer in-charge of the work.

Maintenance of Earth Shoulder (stripping excess soil) - Stripping excess soil from the shoulder surface to achieve the approved level and compacting with plate compactor. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour,hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges etc.. complete as directed as per specification and direction of Engineer in-charge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: White  washing  of  parapet  walls  of  CD  work  and  tree trunks - White washing two coats on parapet walls and tree trunks including preparation of surface by cleaning scraping etc. as per technical specifications. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1916 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour,hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges etc.. complete as directed as per specification and direction of Engineer in-charge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -3- EARTH WORK, EROSION CONTROL AND DRAINAGE
itemList.description: Scarifying  Existing  Granular  Surface  to  a  Depth  of  50  mm  by Mechanical Means using Hydraulic excavator. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 305.4.3 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour,hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges etc.. complete as directed as per specification and direction of Engineer in-charge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Wet Mix Macadam (Plant Mix Method) - Providing,   laying,   spreading   and   compacting   graded   stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory rollerto achieve the desireddensity. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 406 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour,hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges etc.. complete as directed as per specification and direction of Engineer in-charge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -8- TRAFFIC CALMING MEASURES, ROAD SIGNAGES & MARKING (ROAD FURNITURE)
itemList.description: Direction  and  Place  Identification  Signs  with  size  more than 0.9 m2 size Board. - Providing and erecting direction and place identification retro- reflectorised  sign  as  per  IRC:67:2022  made  of  high  intensity grade   sheeting   vide   clause   801.3,   fixed   over   aluminium sheeting, 2 mm thick or Aluminium composite material sheet with overall thickness of 4mm with area exceeding 0.9 m2  fixed over back support frame of min 40 x 40 x 5mm angle mounted on a mild steel circular pipe 65 NB, firmly fixed to the ground by  means  of  properly  designed  foundation  with  M25  grade cement concrete 45 x 45 x 60 cm, 60 cm below ground level as per approved drawing. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 801 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour,hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges etc.. complete as directed as per specification and direction of Engineer in-charge of the work.
